meaning.zh:
“了解内情” 或 “熟悉详情”。

这个短语表达了对某事物非常熟悉、了解所有的细节和流程的意思。它由两个部分组成：“ins” 指内部情况，和 “outs” 指外部情况，合起来表示对所有方面都了如指掌。
meaning.en: The phrase expresses familiarity with all details and procedures of something. It is composed of two parts: "ins" refers to internal details, and "outs" refers to external details, together indicating a thorough understanding of all aspects.

lines.en: She knows the ins and outs of the company's policy.
lines.zh: 她了解公司的政策内情。

lines.en: To perform well in this task, you need to know the ins and outs of the software.
lines.zh: 要在这项任务中表现出色，你需要熟悉软件的每一个细节。

lines.en: He knows the ins and outs of the legal process like nobody else.
lines.zh: 他对法律程序了如指掌，无人能及。
